King Charles Clarifies Harry and Meghan's Royal Status

King Charles III has clarified in a letter to senior government officials that Prince Harry and his wife Meghan remain non-working royals following their move back to the United Kingdom. British media reported that the couple expressed surprise at not being informed of this clarification in advance. The reports indicate Harry and Meghan desire to be public figures rather than private citizens.
